title: Double It Function
description: Read an integer n and print its double (2 * n), computed by a helper function that must RETURN the value. This is a targeted remedial probe for C4-M03 (missing-or-ignored-return): a helper that prints the answer instead of returning it leaves the caller holding None, so every test distinguishes returning reasoning from printing reasoning. Like every EvidencePack, a failure here is observed evidence that can help diagnosis, never a deterministic detection on its own.
